mapper.select: SELECT id, gmt_create AS gmtCreate, gmt_modify AS gmtModify, official_id AS officialId, service_id AS serviceId, can_accept AS canAccept, min_receivable AS minReceivable, is_delete AS isDelete FROM b_official_review_rule WHERE official_id = #{officialId} AND is_delete = 0 AND service_id IN (0, #{serviceId}) ORDER BY CASE WHEN service_id = #{serviceId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, id DESC LIMIT 1
